reconciled.notes: All six keys align one-to-one (A1/B1, A2/B2, A3/B3), so every objective is agreed and nothing is rejected. The exercise items are identical on both sides and every one of the 21 lesson items plus WE1 is placed in exactly one objective. Objective 3 has no lesson exercise items; Ex5-8:1a and Ex5-8:1c are end-of-chapter items used as evidence only. B2's extra wording about choosing a ratio to relate an unknown side or angle was not adopted, since A2's statement matches the same items more tightly. B1's definition evidence (b01636) was left out because it concerns where the ratios apply, not labelling the sides. The heading EMA3P is cited under both objectives 1 and 2 because both finders used it for different objectives. For objective 3, A3's statement was kept because it also covers the 1-over form, which A3's and B3's shared evidence (b01667, b01907) supports.
